title: Reorient the Costume as a Front Shell Band
objective: Replace the accepted TB-R04 top-to-bottom shirt stripe stack with bold front-to-rear bands on the thorax/front shell so the costume reads as striped carapace while the rear abdomen remains dark.
acceptance: at least three broad named stripe meshes are distributed along local body Z with center span at least 0.26, Y span no more than 0.14, and Z span at least 1.8 times Y span
the stripe treatment begins behind the head, is centered on the thorax/front body segment, and ends before the dark rear abdomen
the mesh-bearing Shirt compatibility hierarchy remains but visually reads as a shell, skin, or carapace wrap rather than a vertically stacked humanoid garment
alternating dirty-cream and charcoal/black contrast remains bold and readable from normal gameplay and side/three-quarter camera distances
the rear Abdomen remains predominantly dark and visibly separate from the striped front segment
TB-R04 integrated emissive mask eyes, face readability, six articulated legs, two antennae, squat beetle silhouette, and primitive-only construction are preserved
TB-R01 movement, TB-R03 locomotion, TB-R03A grounded gait, collision, camera, interaction, gameplay loop, and all three levels remain unchanged
TB-001 through TB-R04 regressions, side/three-quarter and normal rendered evidence, Linux export, and all exported levels pass
the change stays within scenes/player.tscn and scripts/player.gd and adds no external asset, animation infrastructure, audio, or gameplay system
